physics_model.normalization: Input field normalized to unit total power before the passive unitary optical mesh
physics_model.forward: Frozen zero-phase 16x16 network with original 48 lossless couplers; display-only attenuation handled separately
physics_model.feedback: Deterministic intensity-only coordinate descent, four bank compensation phases, no direct read of hidden phase target
physics_model.reference: Explicit neutral R=B=128 G=255 reference; later color register retains packet-driven values

limitations: Synthetic and fully deterministic software simulation; not a fabricated or Planck-scale optical processor
96-bit RBG register encodes four 24-bit software banks, not 96 independent photon channels
Feedback tests use a fixed passive mesh transfer matrix; learned 32-phase network is preserved as a separate existing UI subsystem
The compensator optimizes a measured intensity reference, not necessarily the unique original complex field
Calibration score is in-family and not a physical detector noise or drift measurement
Energy normalization removes information about absolute pre-normalization power; green amplitude ratios still modify normalized interference
next: PHOTON-16 v0.11: couple learned phase mesh to RBG field while freezing separate reference calibration; adversarial drifting input and held-out phase profiles.
